Identify the function from a situation

body.en: Planning is deciding in advance what to do and how to do it. Organising is assigning duties, grouping tasks, establishing authority and allocating resources. Staffing is finding the right people for the right jobs. Directing is leading, influencing and motivating employees. Controlling is monitoring performance against standards and taking corrective action.

points.en: Planning: what and how, in advance

narration.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಏನು, ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವುದು. ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ. ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿ ನೇಮಕ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುವುದು. ನಿರ್ದೇಶನ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ. ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷಮತೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸುವುದು.

body.en: The five functions follow the order P-O-S-D-C.

narration.en: The order of the functions. The five functions follow the order P-O-S-D-C.

problem.en: The sales target of a mobile shop chain for March was ₹50 lakh; actual sales were ₹45 lakh. The manager finds the shortfall and asks the team to explain it. Which function is this, and what is the shortfall in per cent?

steps.en: Comparing actual performance with the target and correcting it is controlling.

narration.en: Recap. Planning decides what to do and how. Organising and staffing arrange tasks and people. Directing motivates and guides; controlling checks and corrects.
